model: ROLEX Explorer II 226570 (42 mm steel, white dial, fixed matt 24 h bezel, crown guards, date with Cyclops, 4 hands incl. orange GMT hand, Oyster bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). NEW MODEL adapted from the Rolex Air-King / Explorer 40 template (same recipe; step pipeline/steps/watch_rolex_explorer2.py = variant copy that takes any number of hands and two aperture ellipses; prep pipeline/rolex_explorer2_prep.py): case slab from the alpha silhouette (lugs and crown guards) between the end-link tips, flat matt bezel ring (ellipse outer edge, 0.4 mm outer bevel, fitted face-edge ellipse, polished bevel chamfer down to the window = rehaut outer edge ellipse), flat polygon dial with the native photo map (print, minute track, date window with its Cyclops lens, rehaut engraving and the photographed hands stay in the map), the engraved 24 h scale / triangles / numerals are the bezel texture (steel photo), one fluted crown, Oyster bracelet = brushed outer-link rows + centre-link pieces from the trace, FOUR hands = traced photo outlines (Mercedes hour, orange GMT with hollow arrow head, sword minute, seconds with tail disc and lume ring). Measured on the 226570 photo at 42 mm (scale 22.643 px/mm); tips, hands, hub, crown, bracelet and emissions are per photo. The photo's lighting is baked into the maps (emission), specular is zero on every photo part.

case.note: case slab = silhouette (lugs, crown guards) between the end-link tips (tip_top / tip_bottom, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25), sloping toward the bracelet; bezel = ring (min of the measured ellipse and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, by rays), flat matt face (outer edge at bezel_z - bezel_outer_dz, 0.4 mm outer bevel, face edge = trace aperture.face_edge_r_mm), polished bevel chamfer ring down to the window (trace aperture.window_r_mm) at chamfer_z; rays = aperture.n = 180

dial.note: flat polygon (the window less the chamfer) with the native photo map: print, minute track, numerals, rehaut ring and the photographed hands stay in the map

hands.note: four hands from trace.hands[name].outline_mm (x right / y up from the pivot, as photographed: hour, gmt, minute, seconds) as flat polygons at hands.z[name]; hands_photo = the reference photo projected from the front with its own emission, so lume, Mercedes lines and the orange paint show as photographed. A GMT-style fourth hand is only a measure.hands entry plus a z here.

crown.note: crowns come from trace.crowns: a lathe about the axis (profile = [radius, mm along the axis] from the base point), flutes are texture

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

bracelet.note: bracelet rows and centre-link pieces come from trace.bracelet (rows_mm / pieces_mm); rows follow the silhouette; pieces are rounded rectangles raised piece_lift over the rows; all carry the projected photo (steel_photo material); gap = dark joint between rows
